definitions.explanation: A person who has not yet reached the age of legal adulthood. In Japan, the age of majority was lowered from 20 to 18 in April 2022.

examples.japanese: {未成年|みせいねん}は{飲酒|いんしゅ}できない。
{未成年|みせいねん}の{喫煙|きつえん}は{法律|ほうりつ}で{禁止|きんし}されている。
examples.english: Smoking by minors is prohibited by law.

examples.japanese: {未成年|みせいねん}の{子供|こども}が{契約|けいやく}する{場合|ばあい}は{親|おや}の{同意|どうい}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: When a minor enters a contract, parental consent is required.

notes:
USAGE:
Used both as a standalone noun and as a modifier: {未成年|みせいねん}の{者|もの} (underage person). Japan lowered the age of majority from 20 to 18 in April 2022, but the minimum age for drinking and smoking remains 20.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {未成年|みせいねん}{者|しゃ}: minor (formal)
- {未成年|みせいねん}{飲酒|いんしゅ}: underage drinking
- {未成年|みせいねん}{喫煙|きつえん}: underage smoking
- {未成年|みせいねん}{犯罪|はんざい}: juvenile crime

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {成人|せいじん}: adult (antonym)
- {成年|せいねん}: adulthood, age of majority (antonym)
